Package io.webagent4j.workflow

Class WorkflowConditions

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowConditions
public final class WorkflowConditions extends Object
Factory for the small, fixed set of declarative IWorkflowConditions Phase 0.8 supports.

There is deliberately no expression language, regex, or scripting facade here - see docs/workflow.md#conditions. Missing-variable semantics are fail-closed and asymmetric: exists(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowVariable<?>)/notExists(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowVariable<?>) tolerate a missing variable (that is exactly what they test for), while equals(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowVariable<T>, T), notEquals(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowVariable<T>, T), isTrue(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowVariable<java.lang.Boolean>), and isFalse(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowVariable<java.lang.Boolean>) treat a missing variable as an evaluation failure rather than silently treating it as null or false.

    • not

      public static IWorkflowCondition not(IWorkflowCondition condition)
      Negates condition. condition's own describe()/ referencedVariables() are invoked lazily - only when the returned condition's corresponding method is itself invoked - so a custom condition that throws from either is handled by the same defensive paths as any other condition (WorkflowEngine at evaluation time, Workflow.Builder#build() for referencedVariables()), not eagerly at composition time. A null condition.describe() is preserved as null - never normalized to the literal text "null" - so WorkflowEngine still classifies a malformed wrapped condition as CONDITION_EVALUATION_FAILED.

    • allOf

      public static IWorkflowCondition allOf(IWorkflowCondition... conditions)
      True only when every one of conditions is true. describe() preserves a null child description as null - see describeAll(java.util.List<io.webagent4j.workflow.IWorkflowCondition>).

    • anyOf

      public static IWorkflowCondition anyOf(IWorkflowCondition... conditions)
      True when at least one of conditions is true. describe() preserves a null child description as null - see describeAll(java.util.List<io.webagent4j.workflow.IWorkflowCondition>).
